method: Literal brush outlines, paths and spots. Rasterization only; no noise, random marks, scatter, procedural weave, reference pixels or illumination painting.
height_convention: 128 is neutral. Height is paint relief, not lighting. Suggested peak-to-peak amplitude 0.0005 m for metal, 0.0004 m for leather and 0.0002 m for cloth/parchment; adjust during normal baking.
